claim: Gazebo Harmonic ruby child process orphaned under /init consuming 10-26% CPU
notes: Verified by pstree lineage: ruby /usr/bin/gz sim -s re-parented to init (PID 1) when GZ_PID was killed without child kill.

claim: PX4 SITL pxh.cpp getchar() busy loop floods log to 217 MB and pins 1 CPU core at 100%
metric: PX4 log file size & CPU usage
notes: Verified at source level: case EOF does not break while (!_should_exit) loop and leaves update_prompt=true, printing prompt in infinite unthrottled loop.

claim: Concurrent launch starts takeoff at t=1s before YOLO finishes CUDA initialization
metric: Time to first /tracking/error vs takeoff arming
observed_value: Arbiter armed at t=1.0s while YOLO needed 4.8s for PyTorch CUDA init
expected_value: Takeoff waits for perception pipeline readiness
notes: Fixed via wait_for_vision_before_takeoff. Note: current check is publisher-presence readiness, not verified data stream gate.

claim: Manual teleop fights with YOLO auto-lock causing 14 state flips in 4s
metric: State flips MANUAL <-> TRACKING during teleop injection
expected_value: 0 conflict flips (MANUAL overrides until teleop release)
notes: _reacquire_lock published /tracking/select_target while operator pressed teleop. Fixed by motion_state subscription & manual authority lock.

claim: YOLO publishes error in 416x416 coordinate space scaling bounding box area by 0.5633
notes: Native 640x480 frame is inferred with imgsz=640 (infer_native=True), then projected to 416x416 output coordinate space in publish_error.

claim: Small-box response sluggishness is caused by hard velocity clamp vx <= 0.25 m/s
metric: Percentage of ADVANCING_CLOSE_IN samples clamped to 0.25 m/s
expected_value: Dynamic pursuit speed up to default_walk_speed (1.15 m/s)
notes: Command Saturation, NOT temporal latency. Target walks at 1.11 m/s; drone is clamped to 0.25 m/s, causing geometric lag.

claim: ROS 2 Humble middleware transport delay is the primary root cause of sluggishness
metric: Vision age and control period in nominal conditions
observed_value: Mean vision age = 0.112s (dominated by camera 15 FPS), ROS IPC < 2ms
notes: ROS 2 intra-process / localhost DDS IPC overhead is negligible (< 2ms); slowness was caused by CPU spin, un-readiness, and velocity saturation.

claim: WSL2 DirectX GPU VMBus hang caused context contention between Gazebo and PyTorch
notes: Unisolated finding: Software rendering for headless Gazebo avoids D3D12 vGPU hang, but shifts load to CPU. Hardware vs software rendering was not isolated across trials.

claim: Total ROS 2 parameter count across stack is 86 (37 MA + 24 YOLO + 5 HUD + 20 Realism)
metric: Declared parameter count vs YAML keys
observed_value: 86 declared in source, 86 in tracking_stack.yaml (exact 1:1 match)
notes: Previous 66 count omitted 5 YOLO params and 17 Realism params (which used d alias). True count is 86 with wait_for_vision_before_takeoff.

claim: SITL flight safety validation proves absolute real-flight safety
observed_value: Validated only in Gazebo Harmonic SITL under simplified physics
expected_value: Real-flight validation with safety pilot and physical quadcopter
notes: SITL pass status does NOT establish real-flight safety. Real vehicle requires field validation, physical wind, true optical flow, and COM_OF_LOSS_T <= 1.0s.
